description: Looking for someone who can write a script to scrape all 3000+ US Counties on Redfin on a weekly basis to see active listings vs sold listings (1 month, 3 month, 6 month, 1 year time frames)I use Redfin extensively. The process I use to analyze demand in a market is the following:I choose a county in a state, say cullman county, AL. I then filter for listings 5 acres or more. I then see how many listings are currently available for sale and take note of that number - can call it (Total Active Sales Listing). Then I filter the view to show "Last 1 Month Sold", taking note of that (1 month Sold). Then I filter to "Last 3 Months Sold" (3 months sold). Then filter to "Last 6 Months Sold" (6 months sold). The tablet does this by first identifying the headsets that are available locally with manufacturer specific MDNS broadcast and then sharing a cloud-based unique identifier based on the serial number of the tablet using unity's mirror app, and the local SSID that that tablet is on.Under Android 11 our tablet application was able to identify local headsets and share network information easily. title: Android + iOS simple alarm app with face recognition
description: I am a solo entrepreneur with experience managing software projects. I want to create a cross-platform iOS and Android alarm app with a special method of disabling the alarm: facial expression recognition. The alarm functions would be very simple, similar to the built-in alarm functions of each mobile OS clock app. But instead of a button to turn off the alarm, the user will be prompted to make a specific facial expression. The alarm will only disable when the front-facing camera detects the specified facial expression, for example a smile, or a frown.This alarm app is similar to a reference application that no longer works on modern devices. You can see a description and example images here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.microsoft.mimickeralarmand here:https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/garage/profiles/mimicker-alarm/Note that this previous app is only used for reference. The concept of using face recognition to disable an alarm is not patented, copyrighted, or trademarked, and no infringement of intellectual property is intended or allowed in the development of this app.I believe that both iOS and Android include local, on-device facial recognition libraries that should be able to perform the required face recognition and identify simple expressions such as "frown", "smile", etc. A full list of expressions for detection will be provided, but it should be no more than 5-6 total.The final additional capability of the app would be to capture an image of the user making the expression that disables the alarm each time it activates. The image would be saved to the user's Images or Downloads folder with a Caption showing the facial expression the user was prompted to make for that alarm activation instance. When the image is captured it is shown to the user and a Share function is available within the app to immediately share the captured image to the OS-provided share destinations, e.g. social media apps, etc.An outline of the desired features is shown in bullet points attached here as an image, along with some example images of the app linked to above for reference.Please note: if development is significantly easier and/or cheaper on one platform or the other, iOS or Android, and much harder or more expensive cross-platform, I will consider focusing only on the easier platform for an initial application. But I would prefer cross-platform. I am an Android user so that would be most easy for me to test, but I have access to Mac devoices for testing in a dev environment (I do not have an iOS device at this time).There are additional features to implement in future versions of the app, so a successful developer will have potential future work as well. Thank you for considering my project and I look forward to the possibility of working with you!Budget: $1,000Posted On: February 23, 2024 03:32 UTCCategory: Mobile App DevelopmentSkills:Face Detection, Android, iOS, Mobile App Development, iOS Development, Android App DevelopmentSkills: Face Detection, Android, iOS, Mobile App Development, iOS Development, Android App DevelopmentCountry: United Statesclick to apply
